resorts.name: Banff Sunshine Village
resorts.tagline: 加拿大全天然粉雪标杆 · 横跨大陆分水岭三座雪峰
resorts.taglineEn: 100% Natural Rocky Mountain Powder across 3 Peaks on the Continental Divide
resorts.notes: Snowsnake and lower Strawberry Face are open! Hop on Strawberry Express, carve a few turns down Snowsnake’s groomed centre, then cut across to lower Strawberry Face. The new terrain also includes lower Slush Cup, plus Boutry’s Bowl and Strawberry Surprise, both with marginal coverage. Mix in a lap on Dell Valley or try a feature in the rail park on lower Strawberry. Just getting started? Head to the Mitey Mite learning area for your first turns.
